test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution: The correct answer is '**forgot**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**forgot**'. • It means **'to not be able to remember something'. **(याद न रहना, भूल जाना) • *Example: I’ve **forgotten** her telephone number.* **Correct Sentence:__** *"but we completely **forgot** our umbrellas..."* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Failed**: to not be successful in something. (असफल होना) • **Foiled**: to prevent somebody from succeeding, especially with a plan; to prevent a plan from succeeding. (किसी को सफल न होने देना, विशेषतः योजना बनाकर; योजना को विफल कर देना) • **Finished**: having stopped doing something, using something, or dealing with somebody/something. (ख़त्म होना; किसी वस्‍तु का उपयोग पूरा कर लेना) 46:Tb99, The correct answer is '**pouring**'.
